buckets.name: Green Iron, Steel & Metals
buckets.scope: Production-side decarbonization of iron, steel, aluminum, and other structural metals (scrap sorting/recovery tech is censused in Battery & Materials Recycling)
variations: hydrogen direct reduced iron (H2-DRI) plants and green iron/HBI developers (Stegra, HYBRIT/SSAB, tkH2Steel, GravitHy, POSCO HyREX fluidized-bed, Vulcan Green Steel)
molten oxide electrolysis of iron ore (Boston Metal)
low-temperature aqueous/electrochemical ironmaking and iron electrowinning (Electra, ArcelorMittal Volteron/Siderwin)
flash and single-step novel ironmaking reactors (Univ. of Utah flash ironmaking lineage, Hertha Metals, laser/novel-furnace concepts like Limelight Steel)
hydrogen plasma and smelting reduction (voestalpine SuSteel, HIsarna-type)
alternative chemical reduction routes: sodium-cycle ironmaking (Helios), biocarbon/biochar and bio-syngas reductants
scrap-EAF steelmaking expansion and DRI-EAF hybrid clean steel mills
CCUS retrofits on BF-BOF, top-gas recycling, and steel offgas-to-product (e.g., Carbalyst-type gas fermentation tie-ins)
green aluminum: inert-anode smelting (ELYSIS), low-carbon alumina refining (MVR/electric calcination), low-carbon anodes and remelt expansion
other low-carbon metals production: magnesium from seawater brines (Magrathea), green silicon/ferroalloys, low-carbon titanium (IperionX)

buckets.name: Low-Carbon Cement & Concrete
buckets.scope: Binders, clinker production, kiln tech, CO2 curing/mineralization in building materials, and concrete-chain software (CO2-to-chemicals belongs to Green Chemicals bucket)
variations: clinker substitution and engineered SCMs: calcined clays/LC3, natural pozzolans, ground glass, ag-ashes, tailings/clay-derived SCMs (Terra CO2, Material Evolution, Queens Carbon, Carbon Upcycling, Ecocem ACT)
non-Portland and alternative binder chemistries: geopolymers/alkali-activated, CSA, magnesium-based, brine-based (Partanna), cement-free pours (C-Crete), Brimstone silicate-rock OPC
electrochemical and low-temperature cement/lime synthesis (Sublime Systems, Chement)
biogenic and microbial cements (Biomason, Prometheus Materials)
kiln decarbonization hardware: electric kilns/calciners, solar calcination (Synhelion-Cemex, Heliogen), oxyfuel kilns, micro-modular kilns (Furno, Coolbrook)
CCUS on cement and lime plants: indirect calcination capture (Leilac/Calix), amine post-combustion (Brevik CCS), cryogenic and oxyfuel capture

CO2 mineralization and curing: in-mix injection (CarbonCure), flue-gas-cured concrete (CarbonBuilt, Solidia), carbonated recycled aggregates (Neustark, Carbonaide), reactive calcium carbonate cement (Fortera), olivine-to-SCM (Paebbl, Seratech), synthetic limestone aggregate (Blue Planet)
recycled cement and concrete circularity: EAF-route recycled clinker (Cambridge Electric Cement), smart crushing and recycled fines reactivation
performance additives and cement-reducing admixtures: graphene (Concretene), nano-silica, high-SCM-enabling chemistries, self-healing concrete
concrete AI/QC, EPDs, and low-carbon procurement software/marketplaces (Alcemy, Concrete.ai, Giatec)

buckets.name: Clean Hydrogen Production
buckets.scope: All routes to low-emissions hydrogen: every electrolyzer class plus stack components, methane pyrolysis, geologic, blue-with-CCS, and biological/photo/waste routes
variations: alkaline electrolyzers incl. pressurized and advanced-membrane designs (thyssenkrupp Nucera, John Cockerill, Verdagy, Stargate Hydrogen, Chinese OEMs like PERIC/LONGi/Sungrow)
PEM electrolyzers (Electric Hydrogen, ITM Power, Plug, Siemens Energy, Ohmium, Hystar thin-membrane)
solid oxide and proton-conducting ceramic electrolyzers, incl. industrial-steam- and nuclear-coupled HTE (Topsoe, Sunfire, Bloom, Ceres, FuelCell Energy)
AEM electrolyzers (Enapter, EvolOH, Versogen, Cipher Neutron)

novel electrolysis architectures: capillary-fed (Hysata), decoupled E-TAC (H2Pro), membraneless/high-pressure and supercritical (Supercritical Solutions), intermediate-temperature water vapor (Advanced Ionics), direct seawater electrolysis (sHYp)
electrolyzer components and supply chain: membranes/ionomers (Ionomr), PGM-thrifted and PGM-free catalysts, porous transport layers, bipolar plates, stack manufacturing equipment

methane pyrolysis (turquoise): plasma (Monolith, Plenesys, Sakowin), thermo-catalytic (Hazer, Molten Industries with graphite co-product), molten-media (C-Zero), microwave (Aurora Hydrogen), pulsed combustion (Ekona), distributed at-the-burner (Modern Hydrogen)
natural/geologic hydrogen: exploration (Koloma, Snowfox Discovery, Mantle8, HyTerra, Gold Hydrogen) and stimulated/orange hydrogen incl. subsurface microbial gold hydrogen (Eden GeoPower, Cemvita)

blue hydrogen with CCS and novel reforming: ATR/POX with capture, sorption-enhanced reforming, oxy-combustion (8 Rivers 8RH2), electricity-free solid-oxide gas conversion (Utility Global), in-situ subsurface gasification with downhole membranes (Proton Technologies)

biological, photo-, and waste-route hydrogen: biomass/waste gasification (SGH2, Raven SR, Boson), dark fermentation and microbial electrolysis (HydGene, Electro-Active), photocatalytic/photoelectrochemical (Sparc Hydrogen, SunHydrogen), solar thermochemical cycles, aluminum-water reaction (Found Energy)

buckets.name: Green Ammonia & Fertilizers
buckets.scope: Nitrogen fixation and fertilizer decarbonization, from gigascale green ammonia to modular, electrochemical, plasma, and biological routes, plus ammonia-as-carrier and non-nitrogen fertilizer processing
variations: gigascale green ammonia (electrolytic H2 + Haber-Bosch) project developers and offtake hubs (NEOM/ACWA, Yara, CF Industries, OCI, Indian/Australian megaprojects)
modular and distributed ammonia synthesis with relaxed Haber-Bosch conditions (Talus Renewables, Starfire Energy, Ammobia, Tsubame BHB electride catalysts, Nium)
electrochemical and lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction to ammonia (Jupiter Ionics, NitroFix, Atmonia)
plasma nitrogen fixation and on-farm nitrate production (Nitricity, N2 Applied, VitalFluid)
biological nitrogen fixation displacing synthetic N (Pivot Bio, Kula Bio, Switch Bioworks)
blue ammonia with CCS (retrofit and new-build)
N2O abatement catalysts and low-carbon nitric acid for fertilizer/acid plants
green urea and alternative nitrogen products (CO2-to-urea with captured carbon, green ammonium nitrate, chlorine-free KNO3)
ammonia cracking and ammonia-as-hydrogen-carrier technologies (Amogy, H2SITE membrane reactors, large-scale crackers)
low-carbon phosphate and potash processing and recovered-nutrient fertilizers (struvite recovery, phosphogypsum valorization)

buckets.name: Green Chemicals & Bio/CO2-Based Materials
buckets.scope: Virgin chemical, solvent, and polymer production from biomass, CO2, waste gases, and electrochemistry (end-of-life recycling is censused in Plastics & Polymer Circularity)
variations: fermentation and synbio platform chemicals from sugars (Geno/Genomatica BDO, Visolis, ZymoChem, Cathay Biotech)
chemo-enzymatic and cell-free biomanufacturing (Solugen Bioforge)
waste-gas fermentation: CO/CO2-to-ethanol, acetate, proteins-for-chemicals (LanzaTech, Again, Circe Bioscience)
CO2 electrolysis to CO, syngas, formate/formic acid, ethylene (Twelve, Dioxycle, OCOchem, CERT Systems, Avantium Volta, Oxylus)
thermocatalytic CO2 hydrogenation and e-methanol plants (Carbon Recycling International, European Energy Kassø, Liquid Wind)
CO2- and methane-derived polymers: PHB from methane (Newlight, Mango Materials), CO2-polyols and polycarbonates (Econic, Covestro)
bio-based polymers and monomers: PLA (NatureWorks, Futerro), PHA (Danimer, RWDC), PEF (Avantium), bio-PE/bio-naphtha (Braskem), furanics (Origin Materials)
lignin and wood-derived chemicals and materials (Stora Enso Lineo, UPM Leuna biorefinery, Lignin Industries, Bloom Biorenewables)
green surfactants, solvents, and specialty ingredients incl. on-site electrochemical H2O2 (Sironix, Holiferm, Locus PI, HPNow)
electrified synthesis beyond CO2 and catalyst-discovery platforms (electro-organic synthesis, Mattiq, Sunthetics)

buckets.name: Plastics & Polymer Circularity
buckets.scope: End-of-life recycling and upcycling of plastics, textiles, tires, and composites: enzymatic, chemical, thermal, dissolution, and AI-sorting approaches
variations: enzymatic depolymerization of PET, nylon, and polyolefins (Carbios, Samsara Eco, Protein Evolution, Epoch Biodesign, Birch Biosciences)

chemical depolymerization of condensation polymers: methanolysis (Eastman, Loop), glycolysis (revalyu), microwave-assisted hydrolysis (Gr3n), room-temperature PET (DePoly), PMMA and polyurethane chemolysis
pyrolysis and catalytic cracking of mixed polyolefins (Plastic Energy, Alterra, Nexus Circular, Freepoint, microwave pyrolysis: Resynergi, Pyrowave)
hydrothermal and supercritical-water recycling (Mura HydroPRS, Licella Cat-HTR, Aduro hydrochemolytic)
dissolution and purification recycling without depolymerization (PureCycle PP, Polystyvert PS, multilayer-film delamination like APK)
polyolefin upcycling to higher-value products (Novoloop PE-to-TPU, waste-plastic-to-surfactants/waxes)
textile fiber-to-fiber recycling (Circ, Ambercycle, Syre, Circulose, Eeden)

tire, thermoset, and composite recycling: recovered carbon black (Bolder Industries), devulcanization (Tyromer), carbon fiber reclamation (Fairmat, Vartega), wind-blade-adjacent epoxy chemolysis for industrial composites
AI/robotic sorting, markers, and feedstock prep (Greyparrot, Glacier, AMP, Digimarc and Polytag watermarking, NIR/hyperspectral sorters)

buckets.name: Industrial Heat & Process Electrification
buckets.scope: Cross-industry process heat decarbonization and efficiency: thermal storage, heat pumps, electric heating and furnaces, solar and geothermal heat, waste-heat recovery, and optimization software
variations: solid-media heat batteries delivering steam/hot air (Rondo brick, Antora carbon block + TPV, Kraftblock, MGA Thermal, Brenmiller, Electrified Thermal e-bricks, Polar Night sand, Magaldi fluidized sand)
molten-salt, molten-hydroxide, and phase-change industrial heat storage (Kyoto Group Heatcube, Hyme, EnergyNest concrete)
industrial and steam-generating heat pumps, MVR/steam recompression, and chemical heat transformers (AtmosZero, Heaten, Olvondo HighLift, Skyven Arcturus, Qpinch)
electric resistance and electrode boilers for process steam (PARAT, Vapor Power, hybrid grid-interactive boilers)
advanced electric heating: induction, infrared, microwave, plasma torches, e-beam, and shock-wave/rotodynamic heaters (Coolbrook RDR, Tetronics)
electrified steam crackers, calciners, glass and metal furnaces (BASF-SABIC-Linde e-cracker, electric glass melters)
concentrated solar industrial heat and steam (GlassPoint, Absolicon, Naked Energy, TVP Solar, Sunvapor, Azteq)
geothermal direct-use heat for industrial and district process loads
waste-heat recovery and upgrading: sCO2 and ORC power, thermoacoustic and thermoelectric conversion (Echogen, Climeon)

fuel-flexible decarbonized combustion and efficiency software/hardware: hydrogen-ready and biogas burners, oxyfuel, AI process control (Imubit, Phaidra, Gradyent), high-efficiency motors and drives (Infinitum, Turntide)

buckets.name: Critical Minerals Extraction & Refining
buckets.scope: Primary supply of transition minerals — lithium, copper, nickel/cobalt, rare earths, graphite — across extraction, separation, refining, exploration, substitution, and low-impact mining
variations: direct lithium extraction in all flavors: sorbent/ion-exchange (Lilac, Vulcan A-DLE), membrane (EnergyX, Summit Nanotech), solvent (Adionics), electrochemical/electrodialysis (Lithios, ElectraLith) plus geothermal and oilfield brine co-production (Vulcan, CTR)
lithium from clay and unconventional hard-rock processing (Thacker Pass-style leaching, low-energy spodumene conversion)
copper innovations: catalytic chalcopyrite heap leaching (Jetti, Ceibo), electrochemical reduction (Still Bright), in-situ copper recovery
nickel and cobalt supply tech: cleaner HPAL and tailings handling, bioleaching (Endolith), polymetallic seabed nodules (The Metals Company, Impossible Metals selective harvesting)
rare earth mining and novel separation: chromatography (ReElement), RapidSX (Ucore), solvent-free and biosorption separation, allied heavy-REE projects
critical-material substitution: rare-earth-free magnets (Niron iron nitride, Materials Nexus AI-designed alloys), cobalt-free and PGM-thrifted materials

battery-grade refining and midstream conversion: electrochemical lithium hydroxide (Mangrove), reagent regeneration (Aepnus), HPMSM, synthetic and bio-based graphite (Novonix, Anovion, CarbonScape, Graphjet), microwave-plasma materials (6K)
tailings and mine-waste reprocessing for metals recovery (Phoenix Tailings, Regeneration)
AI-driven exploration, geophysics, and drilling automation (KoBold, Earth AI, Fleet Space, VerAI, Durin)
bio-mining and phytomining (Genomines, Metalplant nickel hyperaccumulators) and low-impact methods: in-situ recovery, surgical/precision mining (Novamera), sustainable process chemistry (Travertine)

buckets.name: Battery & Materials Recycling
buckets.scope: Secondary supply and circularity for the transition: batteries, e-waste, magnets, solar panels, blades/composites, alloy scrap sorting, and traceability software
variations: hydrometallurgical lithium-ion recycling at scale, incl. LFP-specific routes (Redwood Materials, Ascend Elements, Cirba, American Battery Technology, cylib, tozero, Altilium)
direct cathode recycling and upcycling to pCAM/CAM (Princeton NuEnergy plasma, Green Li-ion, Ascend Hydro-to-Cathode)
pyrometallurgical recovery and black-mass pre-processing/logistics (Umicore, Glencore, Hydrovolt, SungEel)
electrochemical and novel-solvent metal recovery (Aqua Metals electrorefining, Nth Cycle electro-extraction, Descycle deep eutectic solvents)
second-life EV battery systems, diagnostics, and state-of-health analytics (B2U, Moment Energy, Connected Energy, Voltfang)
e-waste urban mining and precious-metal recovery (Mint Innovation bioleaching, Excir gold chemistry, formal e-scrap processors)
magnet and rare-earth recycling (Cyclic Materials, HyProMag hydrogen decrepitation, Noveon Magnetics, Ionic Technologies)
solar panel recycling and reuse (Solarcycle, ROSI, We Recycle Solar)
wind blade and fiber-composite recycling (Carbon Rivers, REGEN Fiber, Continuum, Vestas epoxy chemolysis)
advanced alloy scrap sorting and metals recovery plus materials traceability/battery-passport software (Sortera LIBS+AI, TOMRA/Steinert sensor sorting; Circulor, Minespider)
